mapper.select: SELECT * FROM checkin_reconciliation_record WHERE status IN ('PENDING','TICKET_CREATED','NEED_RECONCILE') AND next_attempt_at <= CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3) ORDER BY next_attempt_at,id LIMIT #{limit}
mapper.update: UPDATE checkin_reconciliation_record SET status='LINKED',updated_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3) WHERE id=#{id} AND status IN ('PENDING','TICKET_CREATED','NEED_RECONCILE')

UPDATE checkin_reconciliation_record SET status='NEED_RECONCILE',attempts=attempts+1, next_attempt_at=DATE_ADD(CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3),INTERVAL 30 SECOND),last_error_code=#{error}, updated_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3) WHERE id=#{id} AND status IN ('PENDING','TICKET_CREATED','NEED_RECONCILE')
